patterns.reminder: permission_callback => '__return_true' makes this endpoint public. Confirm it needs no auth, or that the handler validates a token/nonce/secret (see src/ai-authorization/user-interface/callback-route.php). No CS sniff checks capability presence.
Disabling TLS verification exposes remote requests to MITM. Keep sslverify on and CURLOPT_SSL_VERIFYPEER/VERIFYHOST enabled.
Variable variables ($$var) can overwrite arbitrary variables from user input. Use explicit array/object access instead.
phar:// on a filesystem function triggers PHP object deserialization (POP chains). Ensure user-supplied paths cannot contain phar://.
include/require with a superglobal enables Local/Remote File Inclusion. Map requests to a fixed allow-list of paths; never concatenate user input into an include.
